title: CCE's Varma leads partnership with U.S. Department of Energy to advance nuclear construction technologies
summary_en: Amit Varma, the Karl H. Kettelhut Professor in Civil Engineering in the Lyles School of Civil and Construction Engineering, is leading the Purdue Applied Research Institute's Infrastructure Innovation Lab in a partnership with the U.S. Department of Energy to test novel construction materials used to house advanced nuclear reactors.
